privacy.en:
Effective October 8, 2026. KilnPair 1.0.

Local records

Kiln profiles, firings, shelves, manual piece marks, observations, recording photos, drafts and seven metadata snapshots remain in local app storage. No account, developer-operated server, analytics, ads, tracking or automatic cloud sync. Hailink Labs does not receive these records.

Photos and files

Camera access is requested when you choose to take a photo. The system PhotosPicker provides selected photos; cloud-only items may need Apple services and a network connection. Recording JPEG copies are resized to at most 2560 pixels and stripped of GPS metadata; originals are not deleted. You choose export, backup, import and sharing destinations. Providers process files under their own policies. Device backups may include app data according to system settings. ZIP backups contain readable records and photos; protect them before sharing.

Purchases

Apple handles the non-consumable Lifetime purchase and restoration. The app accepts verified transactions and caches verified access for offline use. No payment card details are received. Backups do not transfer purchase access.

Retention

Trash records can be restored. Permanent removal requires confirmation and removes applicable current records and photos; independent backups may retain copies. Metadata snapshots are not full external photo backups and cannot protect against device loss or uninstalling. Save a full ZIP outside the app; delete external copies separately.
privacy.zh-CN:
生效日期：2026年10月8日。KilnPair 1.0。

本地资料

窑炉、窑次、窑层、手工作品标记、观察、记录照片、草稿与七份元数据快照保存在本地。无账号、开发者服务器、分析、广告、追踪或自动云同步。Hailink Labs 不接收这些资料。

照片和文件

仅选择拍照时申请相机权限。PhotosPicker 提供选中照片，云端照片可能需要 Apple 服务和网络。记录 JPEG 最长边2560像素并移除GPS，不删除原照片。导出、备份、导入和分享位置由你选择，接收服务按自身政策处理。系统备份按设备设置可能包含资料。ZIP含可读取记录和照片，分享前保护隐私。

购买

Apple处理非消耗型Lifetime及恢复，App仅接受已验证交易并缓存离线权益，不接收支付卡信息。备份不转移购买权益。

保留和删除

回收站可恢复，永久删除须确认，独立备份可能保留副本。元数据快照不是完整外部照片备份，不能防止丢机或卸载。完整ZIP保存在App外，外部副本另行删除。

support.en:
Record and compare

Create a kiln and firing, name and reorder shelves, add before photos and optional manual piece marks. Confirm loading, begin unloading in reverse shelf order, add after photos, missing-photo reasons and results, then complete the records. Compare one shelf or manually selected shelves and pieces across firings. App states describe recording progress, not temperature or safe opening. Follow your kiln operating instructions.

Export and recover

PDF and CSV are for reading, not recovery. Save a full ZIP to Files. Import validates paths, schema, hashes, images and relationships before appending independent records with new IDs. Existing records are retained, duplicates skipped and purchase access excluded. Save important backups outside this device. On save failure, keep the draft, free space and retry; never uninstall without an external full backup.

Photos

Denied camera access still allows Choose Photo. Enable Camera in system Settings when needed. Cloud-only photos may need downloading. Resized recording JPEGs are not color-calibrated references.

Lifetime and help

Two user firing records include all features free. Archived records count; the labeled sample and Trash do not. Lifetime unlocks unlimited new firings with one purchase, US reference $19.99, subject to storage. No subscription or Family Sharing. Existing records, editing, exports and recovery remain available. Use Restore Purchases with the purchasing Apple Account. Apple displays the applicable price. Include app version, steps and exact error; share private records only if you choose.
support.zh-CN:
记录和比较

新建窑炉与窑次，命名排序窑层，添加烧前照片和手工标记。确认装窑记录后逆序记录出窑，补充烧后照片、缺图原因和结果，再完成。可比较同层或手动选择跨窑次层与作品。状态仅表示记录进度，不表示温度或安全开窑，请遵守设备规程。

导出和恢复

PDF和CSV供阅读，不能恢复。完整ZIP保存到Files；导入先验证路径、结构、哈希、图片和关系，再以新ID追加独立记录，保留现有资料、跳过重复、不导入购买权益。备份保存在设备外。保存失败时保留草稿、释放空间后重试，没有完整外部备份不要卸载。

照片

相机被拒仍可选择照片，需要时在系统设置启用相机。云端照片可能需先下载，缩小JPEG不是色彩校准依据。

购买与帮助

免费两条用户窑次含全部功能，归档计数，示例和回收站不计。一次性Lifetime解锁不限新增数量，美国参考价19.99美元，受存储限制。无订阅或家庭共享，已有读取、编辑、导出和恢复始终可用。使用购买时Apple账号恢复，实际价格由Apple显示。求助提供版本、步骤和错误，仅主动选择时分享私有资料。
